curated-gf-grechen-fuemen-gf-inconsolata: Grechen Fuemen has pen-pressure curves with a faint wedge to them, loose and friendly. Inconsolata brings fixed-width monospace order underneath, which gives a punk gig flyer (maybe) the rhythm of a typewriter.
curated-gf-grey-qo-gf-gentium-plus: Grey Qo looks hand-drawn and offhand, its slim strokes leaving the middle of each line sparse and low. Then Gentium Plus steps in with wide-mouthed, refined letters that give the scribbled heading, on a travel journal for instance, something steady to lean on.
curated-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-gilda-displ: Stretched-out, hand-drawn letters with an e that opens clearly to the right.. Gilda Display answers with swollen dark strokes and near-invisible hairlines, so the soft curves above meet a body of sharp extremes.
curated-gf-hina-mincho-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab is precise and structured, with open throats. Hina Mincho is the literary one, pairing ink-heavy stems with feather-thin lines, while the slab body handles the steady work (even scout and expedition patches).
curated-gf-iansui-clash-grotesk: Personal and friendly, Iansui draws its diagonals as thick as its uprights, with gently flared curve ends. Clash Grotesk below has no thick-and-thin modulation at all, so paragraphs run smooth and approachable.
curated-gf-iansui-gf-m-plus-1-code: Handwritten warmth meets code-terminal structure. Iansui's flared, hand-drawn curves sit above M PLUS 1 Code, whose fixed-width monospace letters and parallel stroke edges make the mix feel, for instance, like a bandcamp page header.
curated-gf-iceberg-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, with a barely-there step from capitals to lowercase. Iceberg above it looks marker-drawn and bold, so the loud heading gets a quiet, unvarying body to settle against.
curated-gf-im-fell-double-pica-gf-sorts-: Old-print and ink-black, with shrunken lowercase and hairline curves meeting heavy stems. Sorts Mill Goudy shares that bookish, small-bodied lowercase but softens the thinning, which is the pair's real strength (think soap bar wrapper).
curated-gf-ingrid-darling-gf-kameron: Ingrid Darling keeps its lowercase short against towering capitals, huddled close with a constant pen pressure. And Kameron, say, for a woodworking shop sign, brings editorial curves that lighten mildly and refuse to close, so longer text stays calm.
curated-gf-inspiration-gf-belgrano: Friendly and inviting, with lowercase dwarfed by big capitals. Belgrano brings a moderate lowercase and open-mouthed curves that stay clear, giving the tightly huddled handwriting a classic, traditional counterweight.
